name: Champagne Chavost Blanc de Noirs
tagline: Champagne, FR - Pinot Meunier - NV
description: Nestled in Chavot village, Champagne Chavost thrives under Fabian Daviaux's daring leadership, breaking with tradition and embracing natural winemaking. This wine showcases the innovative spirit of the cooperative with its 100% Pinot Meunier blend, aged five years on lees. Bright, mineral-forward notes dance with subtle hints of violet and dark berries, yielding a truly delicious, food-friendly Champagne that pays homage to the region's unique terroir.

name: Jean Vesselle "Oeil de Perdrix" Brut
tagline: Champagne, FR - NV - 100% Pinot Noir
description: Oeil de Perdix translates as “Eye of the Partridge” and refers to the pale orange/pink color of this wine from the direct pressing of Pinot Noir. This delicious Champagne is aged 3 years before release and its savory qualities would be incredible with duck rillettes.

name: Jean Vesselle Brut Reserve
tagline: Champagne, FR - NV - 80% Pinot Noir, 20% Chardonnay
description: This Champagne serves as the Traditional or “Opening Act” of the many styles that Jean Vesselle produces. Designated as a “Brut” style, this dry and deliciously fruity champagne (80% Pinot Noir 20% Chardonnay) will have you finding all the reasons to celebrate!

name: Lelarge-Pugeot Rose Extra Brut
tagline: Champagne, FR
description: A delicate, low-dosage rosé Champagne from the evergreen and delightful folks at Lelarge Pugeot. Subtle red berry and floral notes on the nose, and a tangy, zip of acidity on the finish!

name: Champagne Chavost Blanc d'Assemblage
tagline: Champagne, FR - Chardonnay, Pinot Meunier - NV
description: One of our favorite new discoveries. Champagne Chavost is a cooperative winery in the village of Chavot, led by visionary Fabian Daviaux who convinced the co-ops members to embark on a new journey: he would make a range of wines without additives or sulfites. This Champagne marries Chardonnay and Meunier grapes and bursts forth with vibrant freshness. Expect a thrilling tapestry of green apple, quince, and subtle brioche. A testament to the cooperative's bold leap into the future while honoring its past. Cheers to evolution!

name: Champagne Fresne-Ducret 'Le Chemin du Chemin' 1er Cru
tagline: Champagne, FR - Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier, Chardonnay - NV
description: Uncork elegance with this Premier Cru Champagne, a sumptuous blend enriched by reserve wines and five years of lees aging. This wine captivates with a harmonious dance of apricot, white peach, and brioche notes, underpinned by a chalky minerality. Delightfully food-friendly, it adds a touch of sophistication to any meal, from delicate seafood to hearty fare. Savor the sublime and toast to life's special moments.

name: Champagne Gatinois Aÿ Grand Cru Brut 2014
tagline: Champagne, FR - Pinot Noir, Chardonnay - 2014
description: Only produced in exceptional years, the Champagne Gatinois 2014 Brut is a gorgeous expression of what Aÿ Grand Cru fruit can be. The wine is 90% Pinot Noir, providing a sturdy backbone, with the remaining 10% Chardonnay helping to develop more layers of stone fruit and honey. Flavors have matured to a slightly richer profile than the Non-Vintage labels from the house, showing what good time and care can do for the highest quality fruit. A wine to open for your next special occassion, an ideal pairing for scallops, caviar & bellini, and pâté.

name: Champagne Gatinois Aÿ Grand Cru Brut Rosé
tagline: Champagne, FR - Pinot Noir, Chardonnay - NV
description: The Grand Cru village of Aÿ in the northern Montagne de Reims is home to some of the most saught-after Pinot Noir in all of Champagne, and the Gatinois family has been tending vines there since the 1600s. This rosé, though technically from the Vallée de la Marne, shows a lot more in line with Montagne de Reims wines due to the soil type and exposition of the vineyard. Primarily Pinot Noir with a splash of Chardonnay, It punches way above its weight class, showing beautiful notes of cherry, tobacco, and a saline-crisp finish. Sure to correct any rosé-skeptics in your life!

name: Champagne Guillaume Sergent "Bossa Nova" Extra Brut
tagline: Champagne, FR - Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier - NV
description: A Blanc de Noirs composed of Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier from the Premier Cru village of Vrigny in the Montaigne de Reims is bright, pronounced, elegant, and delicious! Sometimes we need prose or poetry to go about a wine, sometimes its named incredibly accurately and you can let the music do the talking. Loads of floral, red fruit, and a tangy, textural finish. A delicious bottle to enjoy with your dance partner on and off the dance floor.

name: Champagne Les Freres Mignon "L'Aventure" Blanc de Blancs
tagline: Champagne, FR - Chardonnay - NV
description: "L'Aventure" was the first cuvée produced by the Mignon brothers, the name inspired by their first foray into production. We should be on to their fourth iteration of this wine by now- a delightful bottling entirely composed of Chardonnay from the villages of Avize, Cramant, and Cuis. The reserve wines go back to 2016, but the bulk of this wine is from this decade. Now that the wine has settled post-discorgement for over a year now, we're seeing some typical Blanc de Blancs notes come through a little more prominently. A comforting, richer Champagne, with plenty of pop and a dry, cider-like finish.

name: Champagne Liebart-Regnier "Excelia" Brut
tagline: Champagne, FR - 2016 - 80% Pinot Noir, 20% Chardonnay
description: A family-run Champagne house that has been converting to fully Organic since 2020. This a Vintage Champagne made from 80% Pinot Noir and 20% Chardonnay. It is Brut, indicating that it is dry, making it a fantastic pairing for caviar, oysters, duck confit or really anything rich and salty!

name: Champagne Liebart-Regnier 'Les Sols Brun' Brut
tagline: Champagne, FR - NV - Pinot Meunier, Pinot Noir, Chardonnay
description: Elevate your celebrations with the delightful Champagne Liebart-Regnier 'Les Sols Brun' Brut, an affordable luxury that is astronomically better than many of its pricier counterparts (think Veuve Cliquot). Hailing from a family-owned winery with generations of expertise, this wine exudes finesse, marrying bright citrus, crisp apple, and delicate brioche notes. Stock up for weddings or parties and savor its effervescence alongside fresh oysters or creamy brie for a memorable ode to joy.

name: Champagne Marguet 'Shaman' Rosé
tagline: Champagne, FR - Chardonnay, Pinot Noir - NV (technically speaking, of course)
description: Champagne Marguet has long been a favorite of those in the know, but it's time to let the secret out. Due to the farming and vinification practices, Marguet creates wines that have become legendary in circles that tend to focus on natural wines exclusively. But don't let any personal bias you may have get in the way of enjoying some truly exceptional wine. After all, nothing is so cut and dry in this arena, and most wines are far more than whatever box they might fall into. Their 'Shaman' cuvées are all Grand Cru fruit and from a single vintage, though the wines are not aged long enough to be labeled as vintage Champagne. Lots of red fruit and briosche, easily one of the most gastronomic Champagnes on hand!

name: Champagne Wafflart-Antoniolli Brut Rosé de Raisin Noir
tagline: Champagne, FR - Pinot Meunier, Pinot Noir - NV
description: Wafflart-Antoniolli is based in Sacy, a small village southwest of Reims. The winemaker has spent a good amount of time making the wine for the Sacy village cooperative, and has used that time to hone his craft, leading to a career of expressive, exact wines. Such as this rosé! Less bright and fruit-forward than their rosé de saigné, this wine shows more restrained fruit and pronounced mineral notes. A gorgeous apertif wine, especially with fresh fruit and Bayonne ham.

name: Champagne Wafflart-Antoniolli Brut Rosé Saignée de Raisins Noirs
tagline: Champagne, FR - Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier - NV
description: This wine might be the darkest, most-intensely fruit-forward rosé Champagne to ever grace our shelves. Wafflart-Antoniolli is based in Sacy, a small village southwest of Reims. They make expressive, exact wines, and this rosé in particular is a staff favorite. Lots of baked strawberry, warm spices, and confectionary notes on the nose, with this refreshing, slightly savory finish. Do people look for Champagne to have with prime rib or braised lamb? Start here!

name: Domaine André Robert "Les Jardins du Mesnil" Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Extra Brut
tagline: Champagne, FR - Chardonnay - NV
description: Domaine André Robert can trace its origins back five generations in the chalky, Grand Cru soils of Le Mesnil sur Oger. Current winemakers Claire Robert and her husband, Jean-Baptiste Denizart, have excelled maintaining the winery's historically contemplative nature, crafting great wines of depth and texture. As expected, this Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs is entirely Chardonnay, aged in bottle for four years, and sees no dosage. Truly a fine and decadent wine that rivals any of the most prestigeous houses in Champagne- a delectible treat with caviar.

name: Domaine André Robert "Les Vignes de Montigny" Extra Brut
tagline: Champagne, FR - Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier - NV
description: A fifty-fifty split of Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier, this wine showcases some gorgeous, clay-rich soils and well-established vines of the Marne Valley, near the village of Montigny. Domaine André Robert owns and tends to 65 individual parcels in the area, and the overwhelming majority are Premier and Grand Cru sites. The bottle explodes with fruit and tension and acidity!

name: Jean Vesselle Rosé de Saignée Brut
tagline: Champagne, FR - NV - Pinot Noir
description: The Jean Vesselle Champagnes have so long been a staple on our shelves that we would forgive you if you haven't noticed them here. The excitement of whatever's new can be overwhelming, but it's so important not to forget the greats that have been around and reliable for so long. And not just around and reliable, but incredibly delicious, complex, and aromatic- especially their rosé de saignée. Rich, red berry fruit, cranberry-like acidity, and a subtle, wild meadow sort of savory quality.

name: Jose Michel Brut Pinot Meunier
tagline: Champagne, France - Pinot Meunier
description: Someday we'll finally meet up with the folks at Jose Michel et Fils and thank them in person for championing Pinot Meunier so prominently! This wine is all bright bubbles and tropical fruit, with an incredible clean and dry finish. It has the perfect balance between fruit and richness which is very likely why this is one of our most popular Champagnes year-round.

name: Lelarge-Pugeot Premier Cru Extra Brut
tagline: Champagne, FR - 65% Pinot Meunier/25% Pinot Noir/15% Chardonnay
description: Lelarge Pugeot's 'Tradition' cuvee is textbook grower Champagne. The Lelarge family has been at it in Vrigny since 1789 and practices Biodynamic farming too. The wine is made up of the big three in the region- Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, and Pinot Meunier- and is just as good at the dinner table as it is as a toast to start off your apero hour.

name: Pierre Gerbais Grains de Celles Rose Extra Brut
tagline: Champagne - 2017 - Pinot Noir/Pinot Blanc/Chardonnay
description: One of the exciting aspects from the wines by Pierre Gerbais is the inclusion of Pinot Blanc in their wines. While all types of of Pinot grapes (noir, gris, blanc, meunier) are permitted in the region, Blanc doesn't get too much attention! The grape brings a unique Alpine wine-like crispness to the wine, which has prominent notes of fresh berries and spring flowers on the nose.
